definition: Restore capability and service delivery available immediately before the presidential transition. Historical resource levels are benchmarks, not automatic funding or hiring targets.
coverage: Selected sourced evidence only; no complete, costed restoration plan is established.

evidence.baseline_status: January 19 service baseline not yet measured; source discusses 2025 operations and staff departures.
evidence.requirements: Measure correspondence backlog, timeliness and processing capacity against a documented pre-transition baseline; develop the workforce and backlog plans recommended by GAO.
evidence.target_basis: Analytical requirements for establishing a restoration plan; not a GAO-costed plan.

evidence.baseline_status: Source documents 2025 AI skills losses; a full pre-transition capability inventory is not established.
evidence.requirements: Identify the skills and service functions lost, assess which capabilities remain necessary, and establish an implementation plan and costed staffing mix.
evidence.target_basis: Analytical requirements informed by GAO's identified skills and planning gaps.

evidence.baseline_status: Source reports grant disruption and reversals; an award-by-award current service baseline remains unverified.
evidence.requirements: Reconcile current grant and legal status, identify interrupted service outputs, and cost the delivery capacity needed for the pre-transition service level.
evidence.target_basis: Analytical restoration requirements; the mixed DHS termination total is not assigned wholly to this topic.

evidence.baseline_status: Source documents award terminations and transfer to State; current service-by-service delivery and legal status require follow-up.
evidence.requirements: Inventory services and delivery partners against the pre-transition portfolio, reconcile transferred and terminated awards, and establish the oversight and staffing capacity necessary to restore identified services.
evidence.target_basis: Analytical restoration requirements informed by GAO; not a recommendation to restore every award or historical staffing count.
